title: Perforce Puppet Enterprise: attackers can run their own code
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 20 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. The severity score is critical (9.4).
rankWhy: Exploitation is confirmed by an authoritative source.

summary: Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. CISA set Dec 1, 2026 as the deadline for US federal agencies. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
